abstract: We report a case of a microcystic variant of meningioma arising in a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis composed predominantly of mature and immature teratoma with elements of seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. We believe this is the first such case of a meningioma arising in a teratoma within a gonadal or extragonadal site. The meningiomatous component showed positive immunohistochemical staining for epithelial membrane antigen and a lack of staining for cytokeratin, factor VIII, CD31, and alpha-fetoprotein. Recognition of a non-germ cell tumor arising in the setting of a teratoma in the testis may be prognostically important depending on the nature of the non-germ cell component and whether it has spread beyond the testis.
abstract_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に生じた微小嚢胞性変異型髄膜腫の症例を報告する。腫瘍は主に成熟奇形腫および未熟奇形腫からなり、セミノーマおよび胎児性癌の成分を伴っていた。髄膜腫成分は上皮膜抗原に陽性、サイトケラチン、第VIII因子、CD31、αフェトプロテインには陰性を示した。精巣の奇形腫内に生じた非胚細胞腫瘍の認識は、その非胚細胞成分の性質および精巣外への進展の有無によっては予後上重要となりうる。
